meta.project: Alpha Project - Technician Recruitment & Job Management Platform

product_overview: Alpha Project is a comprehensive full-stack web application designed to connect skilled technicians with job opportunities while enabling clients and companies to manage projects efficiently. It incorporates robust job management, communication, financial services, and administrative oversight into a unified platform.
core_goals: Provide technicians with verified job opportunities, professional profile management, and secure payment processing
Enable clients to post jobs, oversee projects, and communicate effectively with technical teams
Allow companies to manage workforce, projects, and perform business analytics
Equip administrators with comprehensive system oversight, user management, and security monitoring capabilities
key_features: User Authentication & Authorization with multi-factor login, role-based access, and JWT token management
Admin Panel for detailed user, company, project, and system management
Job Management System with multi-step job posting, AI-powered smart matching, and workflow tracking
Project Management tools for creation, tracking, resource allocation, and quality assurance
Client and Company Management including onboarding and relationship maintenance
Real-time Chat and Communication System with file sharing and audio call capabilities
Digital Wallet and Payment System integrated with PayMob for secure transactions and KYC verification
Audit & Security Systems including comprehensive logging and real-time threat detection
File upload management via Cloudinary and AWS S3
Notification System for real-time user alerts
Advanced Search and Dashboard for data insights and usability
Public Landing Page with marketing and informational content
User Profile & Settings with role-based navigation and personalization
Application Management for job applications and status tracking
Testimonial System for user reviews and feedback
Map & Location Services for geolocation of jobs
Scheduling & Calendar for job planning and management
user_flow_summary: User registration and authentication with role selection and multi-factor verification
Clients post jobs using multi-step forms; jobs are matched with technicians via AI algorithms
Technicians browse, apply, and are assigned to jobs; track project status and submit deliverables
Real-time communication between users with chat, file sharing, and audio calls
Users manage finances through wallet top-ups, withdrawals, and transaction histories with KYC compliance
Admins monitor platform activities via dashboards, audit logs, user and content management interfaces
Notifications alert users about job updates, messages, payments, and tasks
Clients and companies oversee projects, assign tasks, track progress, and handle approvals
validation_criteria: All roles able to register, authenticate, and access authorized features only
Job posting and application processes completed with valid data and proper state management
Real-time chat features delivering messages, files, and calls without loss or delay
Secure payment transactions processed correctly via integrated gateways with KYC verification
Project management tasks created, assigned, updated, and tracked accurately
Audit logs capturing all critical system actions with traceability
File uploads completed successfully with valid format and size constraints
Notifications dispatched and received promptly across platform users
UI/UX adhering to accessibility, responsiveness, and performance benchmarks
System security mechanisms tested for vulnerabilities and compliance with data protection regulations
